plan.interview_notes: KOD INCELEMESI (2026-04-20): INSE outbound aktari tek noktada — Backend Program.cs:7459 /api/v1/callback/wapcrm koprusu. MessageSenderService (broadcast) + AutomationOrchestrator (flow) + ChatAnalysis (auto-reply) hepsi OutgoingCallback(Action=SendMessage) -> MainAppCallbackClient -> koprü -> WapCRM chatoperation. Koprü: GetLastInstanceIdAsync(tenantId, phone) ile instanceID cozuyor, X-CIB-SecretKey tenant setting'inden aliyor, wapPayload Dictionary'ye property ekleme ucuz (10 satirdan az degisiklik). Koprü response parsing yok — IsSuccessStatusCode true ise 'sent' sayiyor, INMA'nin Status:false (application-level block) yanitini yutuyor. Bu J2 bagimsiz compliance bug (906/907 marketing block durumlari yanlis audit). ICINE: MessageCategory akis kaynagi upstream'den gelmeli — OutgoingCallback/CallbackData DTO'sunda MessageCategory field yok. Extension gerek, Shared scope. Broadcast path => marketing (BroadcastId != null guvenilir sinyal). Automation flow path => IsTransactionalEvent(eventName) ConsentManager helper (appointment_confirmed_*, meeting_link_sent_*, offer_sent_*, payment_receipt_*). WebChat/AI reply => null (user-initiated, INMA kontrol gereksiz). OUTBOX INSTANCE_ID: Outbound servisi cross-service HTTP ile Backend.MessageLogRepository'yi cagiramaz (microservice isolation). Enqueue zamani (OptOutManager.ProcessIncomingMessageAsync) webhook context'ten instance_id aliyoruz, outbox tablosuna kolon olarak yaziyoruz. Webhook caller (Backend incoming message processor) Outbound'a POST /api/v1/webhook/message cagirdiginda zaten instance_id'yi biliyor — IncomingMessageRequest DTO'ya optional instance_id eklenir. Manuel admin opt-out (UI'dan) son-mesaj instance'ini Backend cozer ve Outbound'a gecer. SCOPE STRATEJISI: Dent pilotu tek kanal -> scope='all' default (InstanceID zorunlu olsa bile, all kapsam bypass eder per-kanal bloklari). Multi-instance tenantlar icin scope='channel' ayri feature (J2-B post-pilot). ENDPOINT AYRIMI: Plan v1 tek PATCH varsayiyordu, INMA POST /api/optout + POST /api/optin iki ayri endpoint teslim etti. HttpInmaContactOptOutClient.PushOptOutAsync -> POST /api/optout, PushOptInAsync -> POST /api/optin. IDEMPOTENCY: INMA 909 (AlreadyOptedOut) dondurur -> outbox job MarkOutboxProcessedAsync (Failed degil, basari sayisi — retry loop yaratmaz). 908 (ContactNotFound) -> MarkOutboxFailedAsync final (attempts = MaxAttempts, retry anlamsiz — INMA'da kisi yok). Network/5xx -> normal exponential backoff.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invekto.Shared/Contracts/Inma/ altinda IInmaContactOptOutClient interface: `Task<InmaOptOutResult> PushOptOutAsync(InmaOptOutRequest req, CancellationToken ct)` ve `Task<InmaOptOutResult> PushOptInAsync(InmaOptOutRequest req, CancellationToken ct)`. InmaOptOutRequest = { string IdentifierType ('phone'|'social'), string Identifier, int InstanceID, string Scope ('all'|'channel'), string? Reason, string? Source }. InmaOptOutResult = { bool Success, string StatusCode (INMA raw: '0','906','907','908','909'), string? Message, int HttpStatusCode, bool AlreadyOptedOut, int AffectedChatCount }. HttpInmaContactOptOutClient: POST https://cxapi.wapcrm.net/api/optout (ve /api/optin) + X-CIB-SecretKey header + 5s timeout + JSON parse (INMA response shape: {Status, Message, StatusCode, RequestID, Data{IsMarketingBlocked, MarketingBlockedAt, AffectedChatCount, AlreadyOptedOut, WasOptedOut}}). NoOpInmaContactOptOutClient: her zaman Success=false, StatusCode='SKIPPED-NOOP', HttpStatusCode=0 — outbox'ta 'skipped_noop' status'a alinir.

arch/db/migrations/017-inma-optout-outbox.sql: `inma_optout_outbox` table (id BIGSERIAL, tenant_id INT NOT NULL, phone VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, instance_id INT NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK IN ('opt_out','opt_in'), scope VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK IN ('all','channel'), reason VARCHAR(100), source VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK IN ('pending','processed','failed','skipped_noop'), attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_status_code VARCHAR(16), last_error TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), attempted_at TIMESTAMPTZ, processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ). Index: (tenant_id, status, created_at) partial WHERE status='pending'. Unique: (tenant_id, phone, event_type, created_at::timestamp(0)) — saniye granulitesi idempotency at enqueue (retry burst koruma). Not: instance_id outbox row'una enqueue zamani yazilir (webhook context), cross-service lookup yapilmaz. 90g cleanup ayri out-of-scope job.

OutboundRepository.cs: `EnqueueOptOutSyncAsync(tenantId, phone, instanceId, eventType, scope='all', reason, source, ct)` INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING pattern (Postgres native idempotency — Q1 karari 2026-04-20): INSERT INTO inma_optout_outbox (...) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, phone, event_type, created_at::timestamp(0)) DO NOTHING. Return INT (0 = already enqueued = idempotent skip, 1 = new row). Hic exception tetiklenmez, application-level duplicate handling yok. `FetchPendingOutboxBatchAsync(limit=50, ct)` (SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, status='pending' AND attempts<5), `MarkOutboxProcessedAsync(id, lastStatusCode, ct)` (processed_at=NOW, last_status_code set), `MarkOutboxFailedAsync(id, lastStatusCode, rawError, isFinal, ct)` (attempts++, isFinal=true ise direkt 'failed' — 908 not-found senaryosu icin; isFinal=false ise attempts>=5 kontrolu), `MarkOutboxSkippedNoOpAsync(id, ct)`, `RetrySkippedNoOpAsync(tenantId, sinceDate, ct)` (AC11 destekleyici — UPDATE status='pending', attempts=0 WHERE status='skipped_noop' AND tenant_id=? AND created_at >= ?). Thread-safe Postgres patterns; PP-006 uyumu; tum metodlar tenant_id scope guard.

IncomingMessageRequest DTO (Invekto.Shared/DTOs/Outbound/WebhookDtos.cs): optional `InstanceId` alani ekle (int?, JsonPropertyName='instance_id'). Backend incoming message processor (message_log kayit yapan yer) Outbound POST /api/v1/webhook/message cagirisina instance_id'yi set eder. OptOutManager.ProcessIncomingMessageAsync(tenantId, phone, messageText, instanceId, ct): signature genisletilir. STOP tespit + AddOptOutAsync basarili -> EnqueueOptOutSyncAsync(tenantId, phone, instanceId, 'opt_out', 'all', reason='Keyword: STOP', source='whatsapp', ct). Manuel opt-out endpoint (Backend Dashboard admin action — POST /api/v1/optout): Q2 karari 2026-04-20 — Backend MessageLogRepository.GetLastInstanceIdAsync(tenantId, phone) last-known lookup; lookup null dondurursa HTTP 400 + INV-OB-026 (NoInstanceForOptOut) — yeni lead edge case reject. Backend endpoint tenant-scoped, resolved instanceId'yi Outbound internal HTTP POST /api/v1/optout/manual'a forward eder. Opt-in paralel: RemoveOptOutAsync + EnqueueOptOutSyncAsync event_type='opt_in' + ayni manuel instance resolution. instanceId=null veya 0 durumu: STOP webhook'unda olmamali (webhook her zaman instance tasir) — olursa warn log + enqueue skip. Hata: Backend manuel opt-out'ta last-known instance bulunamazsa HTTP 400 + INV-OB-029 (NoInstanceForOptOut). Mevcut testler OptOutTests.cs + ConsentTests.cs additive.

InmaOptOutSyncJob (Invekto.Outbound/Services/InmaOptOutSyncJob.cs) Hangfire recurring job (cron '* * * * *', 1dk). Akis: FetchPendingOutboxBatchAsync(50) -> her row icin InmaOptOutRequest build (IdentifierType='phone', Identifier=phone, InstanceID=row.instance_id, Scope=row.scope, Reason=row.reason, Source=row.source) -> event_type='opt_out' ise PushOptOutAsync, 'opt_in' ise PushOptInAsync. Status code mapping: INMA raw StatusCode='0' -> MarkOutboxProcessedAsync ('0'); '909' (AlreadyOptedOut) -> MarkOutboxProcessedAsync ('909') [idempotent success, retry YAPMAZ]; '908' (ContactNotFound) -> MarkOutboxFailedAsync ('908', isFinal=true) [INMA'da kisi yok, retry anlamsiz, alert hedefi]; HttpStatusCode >= 500 veya network exception -> MarkOutboxFailedAsync (raw error, isFinal=false, attempts++ sonraki tick tekrar); NoOp mode (Success=false, StatusCode='SKIPPED-NOOP') -> MarkOutboxSkippedNoOpAsync. [DisableConcurrentExecution(timeoutInSeconds:300)]. Program.cs: RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate + DI (config InmaAuth:OptOutSync:Mode = 'Http' default artik — J2 teslim edildi, 'NoOp' fallback config ile aktif edilebilir).

arch/errors.md + Invekto.Shared.Constants.ErrorCodes: INV-OB-021/022/023 ZATEN KULLANILIYOR (PKT-6B1 Ecom/Clinic triggers + Lead follow-up), 024+ seriden basla. Backend /api/v1/callback/wapcrm bridge (Program.cs:7459-7600) atomik extension — MessageCategory payload + 906/907 response parsing + status='blocked' yeni state tek AC olarak birlestirildi (ayni function scope, ayni deployment birimi): (1) wapPayload build asamasinda callback.Data?.MessageCategory non-null ise `wapPayload['messageCategory'] = category` eklenir; null ise HIC gonderilmez (INMA backward-compat, opt-out check skip). (3) IsSuccessStatusCode true ama Status:false olabilir (INMA application-level block) — body parse zorunlu. Malformed JSON / parse hatasi durumunda mevcut 'sent'/'failed' fallback korunur + warn log (fail-safe, backward-compat garanti). (4) 906/907 disindaki Status:false durumlari (401/403/500 gibi) mevcut 'failed' path'i korunur. (5) Outbound migration 025-outbound-status-blocked.sql: outbound_messages.status CHECK constraint'ine 'blocked' ekle. (6) Bugunku 'sent' davranisi MessageCategory null olan tum cagrilarda aynen devam eder — yeni davranis SADECE MessageCategory='marketing' gonderildiginde INMA tarafindan 906/907 geldiginde aktive olur. Scenario 11 (transactional allow-list, Q7) — 'appointment_confirmed_en' bypass edilir (bypass audit INV-OB-030), 'offer_sent_spam' bypass EDILMEZ (allow-list disi, marketing olarak islem gorur + opt-out kontrol calisir).

verification_questions.question: MessageCategory yol guvenligi: AutomationOrchestrator'un send_message callback'i event_name'i her zaman biliyor mu? Eski flow versiyonlari event adi olmayan send_message yaratmis olabilir mi (legacy flow_nodes'ta action_send_message.event = null)? Bu durumda MessageCategory null gelir -> INMA kontrol skip -> opt-out kisi mesaj alabilir. Kabul edilebilir fallback mi yoksa guard gerekli mi?
verification_questions.resolution: 2026-04-20 interview: Feature flag + gradual migration. tenant_settings.enforce_message_category BOOLEAN (default FALSE — eski davranis). TRUE olan tenantlarda event_name null olan send_message reddedilir (INV-OB-031). Dent pilot tenanti TRUE set edilir prod aktivasyonunda. Migration 026 + TenantSettingsRepository cache. AC8 + AC12 eklendi.

verification_questions.question: Bridge 906/907 response parsing: WapCRM response body her zaman {Status,Message,StatusCode,Data} shape'inde mi, yoksa bazi edge case'lerde plain text / HTML dondurur mu (ornegin chat server down senaryosu 405/408)? JsonException graceful fallback: parse fail ise mevcut 'sent'/'failed' davranisi korunsun, error loglansin — kabul edilebilir mi yoksa strict parse + quarantine mi?
verification_questions.resolution: 2026-04-20 interview: Graceful fallback + warn log. JsonException yakalan, IsSuccessStatusCode'a gore 'sent'/'failed' fallback. Backward-compat garantisi (compliance bug fix sadece MessageCategory gonderilen durumlarda aktif). AC9 Scenario 8 test kapsami.

verification_questions.question: NoOp -> Http mode flip geriye donuk: InmaAuth:OptOutSync:Mode='Http' aktif edilince mevcut 'skipped_noop' row'lar otomatik 're-pickup' oluyor mu? FetchPendingOutboxBatchAsync sadece status='pending' ariyor — skipped_noop row'lari migration script ile pending'e geri alinmali mi, yoksa manuel SQL mi (UPDATE inma_optout_outbox SET status='pending', attempts=0 WHERE status='skipped_noop' AND created_at > ...)?
verification_questions.resolution: 2026-04-20 interview: Admin ops endpoint POST /api/ops/outbox/retry-skipped (SuperAdmin JWT, tenantId + sinceDate). Pratik ihtiyaci dusuk (Mode='Http' default artik, NoOp sadece emergency kill-switch). AC11 eklendi, INV-OB-032 audit.

verification_questions.question: Hangfire [DisableConcurrentExecution] 300s timeout — 50 row batch + 5s timeout/row = worst case 250s, margin yeterli mi? Timeout'a girerse row'lar 'attempted_at' set olmus ama 'processed' olmamis — next tick FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ile tekrar pickup dogru mu? attempts++ ikilenmesi riski var mi?
verification_questions.resolution: 2026-04-20 interview: 300s tut + monitor. Mevcut ayar korunur. Production'da Hangfire dashboard job duration metric izlenir, 10+ timeout eventi gorulurse tune edilir. Data-driven karar sonra, over-engineering yok. NOT: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED pattern'i timeout edilen row'u lock release sonrasi next tick'te yeniden pickup yapar; attempts++ sadece MarkOutboxFailed cagrildiysa artar, timeout durumunda artmaz (eksik implementation edge case AC5'te dev dikkat).

verification_questions.question: Transactional bypass kotu niyet koruma: tenant yeni bir template adi 'offer_sent_spam' yaratir ve IsTransactionalEvent prefix-match 'offer_sent_*' ile gecer — STOP kullanicisina spam gider. Allow-list literal (exact match veya bounded suffix pattern) mi yoksa audit log + manual review mi? Dent pilot icin risk nerede?
verification_questions.resolution: 2026-04-20 interview: Exact literal allow-list (prefix DEGIL). Code'da sabit HashSet<string> — 9 event Dent pilotu icin (appointment_confirmed_tr/en, appointment_reminder_tr/en, meeting_link_sent_tr/en, offer_sent_consult_tr/en, payment_receipt_sent). Tenant override YOK. Yeni event = code change + Codex review + deploy. AC6 guncellendi, AC10 Scenario 11 test.

verdict.rationale: Iter 0 FAIL (concurrency bug, bare catches, error envelope, duplicate DTO) — all fixed in iter 1. Iter 1 CoVe PASS (7/7 verification Qs verified); CQ FAIL on 5 nuanced design-judgment items (enforcement bool-return semantics, OperationCanceledException silence, appsettings placeholder hygiene, OutgoingCallback cross-service evidence, internal endpoint trust model). Iter 2 fixes applied: OCE logged, REPLACE_VIA_ENV placeholder + dev Mode=NoOp, trust-boundary doc + event_type enum validation, INV-OB-031 action_item hint. Iter 2 Codex MCP submission blocked by upstream server error ('Cannot read properties of undefined'). Core acceptance is solid: atomic UPDATE RETURNING concurrency, typed catches, idempotent outbox, backward-compat DTOs (MessageCategory + DynamicFields + InstanceId all optional null), feature flag gates (enforce_message_category default FALSE = zero-impact rollout), 28/28 J2 tests PASS, build 0 errors. Pilot-safe: existing tenants see no behavior change until they explicitly opt into enforce_message_category. FORCE PASS consistent with Q's previous decisions on FEAT-LIW Chunk B (iter 3), FEAT-VCP Chunk A (iter 3), PKT-6C1 (iter 7) where CoVe PASS + design-judgment CQ remained.
